name: Dev Stats
author: qempexe
description: Contribution activity grid for GitHub, GitLab and Forgejo/Gitea/Codeberg in the Omarchy bar, using your existing gh/glab/tea/fj terminal logins.

barWidget.description: Contribution grid for GitHub, GitLab and Forgejo

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Follow theme matches your Omarchy theme live. Window borders takes the accent from your theme's window border. Custom lets you choose the background, text and accent. Monochrome removes every hue.

schema.label: Custom background
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used exactly as you pick them. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used exactly as you pick them. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Custom accent
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used exactly as you pick them. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: Always readable keeps your theme's text color, and switches to black or white when the window is too light or too dark for it. My text color uses the Text color from Custom colors. Custom colors always use their own text color.

schema.label: Grid color
schema.description: The color of the busiest days, on the bar and in the grid. Quieter days are darker shades of it.

schema.label: Card style
schema.description: Soft fills cards lightly, outline draws a border only, flat has neither.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much air there is between things.

schema.label: Roundness
schema.description: 0 is square, 20 is very round. The grid's squares follow it too.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: 1 is normal, 1.25 is a quarter bigger.

schema.label: Show streaks
schema.description: The current and the longest streak next to the total.

schema.label: Show the legend
schema.description: The Less to More row under the grid.

schema.label: Show the numbers
schema.description: Cards under the grid: contributions, active days, longest streak and busiest day.

schema.label: Window width
schema.description: How wide Dev Stats opens. The grid's squares grow with it.

schema.label: Window height
schema.description: How tall Dev Stats opens.

schema.label: Open as
schema.description: Where the bar button opens Dev Stats. You can always pop it out or dock it back from the header.

schema.label: Window outline
schema.description: Draw the edge in your window border's colors instead of a plain neutral line.

schema.label: Outline gradient
schema.description: Use the window border's whole gradient, at its angle, when it has more than one color.

schema.label: Outline color
schema.description: The one color the outline takes when it isn't a gradient.

schema.label: Window tint
schema.description: How much of the accent washes over the background. 0 keeps it plain.

schema.label: Window opacity
schema.description: 100 is solid.

schema.label: Show platform icon
schema.description: The GitHub, GitLab or Forgejo logo before the squares.

schema.label: Days on the bar
schema.description: How many recent days show as squares.

schema.label: Square size
schema.description: How big each day's square is on the bar.

schema.label: Square roundness
schema.description: 0 is square, 7 makes them dots.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: What a left click on the widget does. Right click always opens the settings.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What a middle click on the widget does.

schema.label: Refresh automatically
schema.description: Fetch new numbers in the background. Off means only when you ask.

schema.label: Refresh every
schema.description: Minutes between updates. Each one runs your own gh, glab or curl.
